ctaHeading: Fairfield's landscapers are ready — let's transform your garden.
aboutText: Hakea Projects, led by Luc and Alex, provides expert landscaping and garden services in Fairfield and across Melbourne. With a focus on quality and customer satisfaction, we transform outdoor spaces into beautiful, functional areas. Our team specialises in everything from regular maintenance to complete garden redesigns, ensuring your property looks its best year-round. We understand Melbourne gardens and use our expertise to create sustainable, low-maintenance solutions that exceed expectations.
servicesText: From garden maintenance to full landscaping projects, we offer comprehensive services tailored to your needs. Our team handles everything from pest prevention to property value enhancement, ensuring your outdoor space is both beautiful and functional.
